name: Kohin
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Only syntax/morphology sketches (Poerwadi et al. 1998 Sintaksis; Iper et al. 2003 Morfologi) and a survey wordlist; no phonology plausibly covering stress located.

sources.citation: Poerwadi, Petrus; Dunis Iper; Mariyedi. 1998. Sintaksis Bahasa Seruyan. Jakarta: Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa, Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan. xii+156 pp. (CORE 227149315 = oai:repositori.kemdikbud.go.id:4386)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: HathiTrust digitized, search-only (in copyright); interlibrary loan
sources.note: No word-stress statement. Syntax only (frasa, klausa, kalimat). The single 'tekanan' passage is sentence-level: Bab IV, kalimat imperatif, printed p.65 (PDF p.77): 'Intonasinya ditandai dengan nada tinggi atau tekanan keras pada verbanya' (imperatives marked by high pitch or strong stress on the verb).

sources.citation: Iper, Dunis; Petrus Poerwadi; A. Purwaka. 2003. Morfologi Bahasa Seruyan. Jakarta: Pusat Bahasa, Departemen Pendidikan Nasional. viii+97 pp. (repositori.kemdikbud.go.id eprint 3159, via Wayback 20250617020400)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing. Chapters: morfem dan kata, proses morfologi, proses morfofonemik; no phonology/suprasegmental section; no occurrence of tekanan/aksen. Introduction (p.2-3) and Daftar Pustaka (p.96) cite the unpublished report Poerwadi dkk. 1997 'Fonologi Bahasa Seruyan' (Palangkaraya). Data from Kohin dialek Benteng Kiham (Rantau Pulut, Kec. Seruyan Tengah).

sources.note: The only phonological description of Kohin/Seruyan known; Pusat Bahasa fonologi reports of this series routinely include a 'fonem suprasegmental (tekanan)' section stating stress placement. Cited by Iper et al. 2003 (p.3, p.96). Not digitized in repositori.kemdikbud.go.id (1997-2000 listings checked), CORE, or Garuda; likely held at Perpustakaan Badan Bahasa Jakarta / Balai Bahasa Kalimantan Tengah / Universitas Palangka Raya.
